speaker: william_shakespeare
text: A penny, Davy. I am for Paul's Wharf when the news is done. I am not buying a longer fare.

speaker: davy_gannet
text: A penny it is. Raleigh's gone for gold, the Spaniard's in Kent, and it'll rain.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Gone. You are sure of gone.

speaker: davy_gannet
text: Gone since Thursday. Forty ships, and the Queen's blessing on them. I saw the victualling barges load salt beef below the Bridge. That is how a man knows.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Forty is a large word before breakfast. Salt beef I will believe. I have not counted a fleet.

speaker: (the sailor)
text: Guiana. That is where the men have their heads in their chests. Every one of them. Ask anyone who has not been.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I have met such men in the City. Their heads sit where other men's heads sit. They talk, which is the trouble.

speaker: davy_gannet
text: Talk is how news comes up the river. Five days from the west, and I had it with the oars. You may doubt the blessing. You may not doubt the beef.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The beef, then. The blessing I have not seen. And it is not raining.

speaker: davy_gannet
text: It will. A penny's worth of sky is still a sky. Off you go, if Paul's Wharf will have you. I have said what the oars said.
